behaviors.search-assignees: Search the assignee menu by person name to find an available filter option.
behaviors.filter-by-assignee: Choose a person or Unassigned to show only tasks assigned to that choice, with task counts shown in the menu.
behaviors.combine-filters: Apply a status filter and an assignee filter together to show tasks matching both.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Choose Ana Lima to see the tailored empty message that says nothing is assigned to her.
behaviors.clear-filters: Use Clear filters to reset the status and assignee selections and restore all tasks.
